title: [Main]-Payment discount tolerance is doubled when posting a vendor payment
summary: Fixed a bug where payment discount tolerance was calculated twice for vendor payments with Applies-to ID in foreign currency, causing inflated bank amounts and sign errors in GL entries.
key_points: Removed guard preventing netted amounts from being persisted when Applies-to ID was set
Added re-entrancy guard to prevent infinite recursion during amount validation
Payment discount tolerance now calculated correctly for multi-invoice vendor payments
Fix applied across all localizations (W1, CH, FR, IT, NL)
Added regression tests for vendor payment tolerance scenarios
